notes.title: The Alice Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41864880/e8004b1ef17d02709c90a08dc58fa4ada9860413.png[/img]

We've got some brand new content here for you guys, as promised. This time we're focusing on Alice! This means that all of the girls featured in the game now have dedicated erotic scenes!

The new content can be unlocked after completing the game for the first time- there should be an alternate start screen which lets you select the additional story path you would like to see!

CHANGELOG

[list]
[*] - Brand new story path focusing on Alice
[*] - 5 New Unique CGs
[*] - Various additional pop-up arts
[*] - Various bug fixes to the gallery
[/list]

notes.title: The Double Date Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41864880/6c94c4b762b3a80663d763ecc785738085bbfa88.png[/img]

We've got some brand new content here for you guys, as promised. You'll be able to unlock story content and sex scenes for not one, but TWO of the supporting cast in Sequoia! Both Sara and Dubois get their own little segments- expanding out the roster of content by quite a bit!

The new content can be unlocked after completing the game for the first time- there should be an alternate start screen which lets you select the additional story path you would like to see!

CHANGELOG

Sara:
[list]
[*] - 5 New Unique CGs
[*] - 14,465 Words of Story & Dialogue
[*] - 27 Variant CGs
[*] - 34 Pop-Out Panels
[/list]

Dubois:

- 5 New Unique CGs
- 17,589 Words of Story & Dialogue
- 25 Variant CGs
- 25 Pop-Out Panels

notes.title: Bugfix: Loading a save made on a choice, black screen
notes.content:
Fixed an issue when loading a save made on specific choice prompts.
The issue would cause a blank screen and not allow any input from the user, other than to exit out of the game and restart.

notes.title: Fixed issue with Gallery
notes.content:
Corrected issue with scene 4C. 
Comic panel 4 was never displayed, instead showed panel 5 twice.
Now shows the correct images for the scene.

notes.title: Hard Times at Sequoia State Park is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41864880/617051c7dbb06481090c5334e24b1375e2013795.png[/img]

Hey guys, we're live! It's been a long road getting here, but we've made it! We hope you are all excited as we are and will enjoy the game! The journey isn't quite over for us yet though, as we've got some free updates coming to the game in the following months! Eager for more content? Rest assured it's on the way!

In the meantime, we'd love to get feedback from you guys! Like the game? Let us know and leave a review! We're excited to hear from you guys!
